regions.name: Rio Purus
regions.quote: The fish were collected in the surroundings of Labrina in the Rio Mucuim, in the central part of the Rio Purus.

regions.name: Rio Urucu
regions.quote: According to the exporters, very similar fish also occur in the Rio Urucu and Rio Jutai, both tributaries of the Solimões, but very far away from the Rio Mucuim.
